title: Vps37a loss induces V-ATPase genes and represses synaptic membrane transcripts in MB and MB/P/MY neurons
exact_observed_result: Vps37a guide assignment yielded 138 FDR genes in 155 MB Glut and 25 in 191 MB P MY GABA, repeatedly inducing Atp6v1h or Atp6v0b while decreasing membrane/synaptic genes such as Gria4, Gria3, Asic1, and Cntn1.
biological_interpretation: ESCRT-I/VPS37A disruption pushes selected posterior neurons toward endolysosomal acidification stress and erodes synaptic membrane identity.

evidence_records.statistics: 167 gene-by-cell-type hits had FDR<0.05, representing 160 unique genes. Counts by cell type were 155 MB Glut=138, 191 MB P MY GABA=25, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA=2, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut=2; the remaining 15 of 19 Vps37a signatures had zero FDR<0.05 genes.
evidence_records.description: Distribution of downstream FDR-significant responses for Vps37a across cell types.

evidence_records.statistics: 58 perturbed cells versus 20353 controls; 138 FDR<0.05 genes. Top examples: Rhoq logFC 1.678 FDR 8.59e-06; Ly6h logFC -1.283 FDR 2.36e-04; Atp6v0b logFC 0.541 FDR 3.84e-04; Ddit3 logFC 1.759 FDR 6.43e-04; Tnfrsf12a logFC 2.451 FDR 0.00107; Kifc2 logFC -0.777 FDR 0.00107; Jun logFC 1.705 FDR 0.00373; Atp6v1h logFC 0.848 FDR 0.00918.
evidence_records.description: The largest Vps37a FDR signature, containing stress, lysosomal-acidification, and synaptic/neuronal negative genes.

evidence_records.statistics: 33 perturbed cells versus 10309 controls; 25 FDR<0.05 genes. Atp6v1h logFC 0.898 FDR 0.00375; Tnfrsf12a logFC 2.602 FDR 0.0188; Cd63 logFC 2.406 FDR 0.0291; Atp6v0b logFC 0.485 FDR 0.0323; Lynx1 logFC -1.182 FDR 0.0188; Rasgrp2 logFC -1.669 FDR 0.0188; Gria4 logFC -0.925 FDR 0.0288; Asic1 logFC -1.429 FDR 0.0288; Rhbdl1 logFC -1.164 FDR 0.0291; Gria3 logFC -1.300 FDR 0.0314.
evidence_records.description: The second-largest Vps37a response, dominated by positive lysosomal/stress genes and negative membrane/synaptic genes.

evidence_records.statistics: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA: 22 perturbed cells, two FDR genes, Lhfpl3 logFC -2.130 FDR 0.0210 and Kifc2 logFC -1.248 FDR 0.0265. 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut: 20 perturbed cells, two FDR genes, Atp6v1h logFC 1.152 FDR 0.0163 and Metap1d logFC 1.838 FDR 0.0296.
evidence_records.description: Low-depth but FDR-significant Vps37a effects outside the two MB signatures.

caveats: Vps37a mRNA was not FDR-depleted, and the 066 and 110 CNU signatures contained only two FDR genes each.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.

citations.citation: UniProtKB Q8NEZ2, Vacuolar protein sorting-associated protein 37A, human.
